# Vendored foxglove_msgs

Copied from the ROS 2 package under
[foxglove/schemas](https://github.com/foxglove/schemas) (`ros/src/foxglove_msgs`),
because a ready ARM64 `foxglove_msgs` deb was not available for Jazzy on this Pi.

Upgrade path: replace this directory with a newer release from the same upstream
package and rebuild with `colcon build --packages-select foxglove_msgs`.
